༄༅/ /dpal khro bo'i rgyal po rta mchog rol ba'i las byang dregs pa kun 'dul zhes bya ba bzhugs/

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /dpal khro bo'i rgyal po rta mchog rol ba'i las byang

dregs pa kun 'dul zhes bya ba bzhugs/ na mo gu ru ha ya gṛ bā ya/ /nyin byed 'bum gyi snang ba las lhag cing*/ / dus mtha'i 'bar byed kyis kyang mi dpogs pa'i/ /rab dmar 'jigs byed chen po'i skur ston pa'i/ /rta mgrin khro bo'i rgyal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de nyid mchod pa'i cho ga yan lag bcas/ /ma tshang med pa gsal bar brjod 'dod kyi/ /yi dam srung ma gnas gsum mkha' 'gro'i tshogs/ /rje btsun bla ma mgon bcas 'dir byin rlobs/ /'phrin las kun gyi 'dod 'jo zhing*/ /dregs ldan ma lus 'dul ba dang*/ khams gsum dbang phyug cher 'gyur zhing*/ /bdud rnams nyams par byed pa'o/ / 'dir dben pa'i gnas su 'di nyid kyi bris sku bkram/ bla bre la sogs pa'i mdzes par byas/ bris sku'i mdun du stegs bu la rten gtor rtsa ba zlum po/ rtse mo gru gsum smug rtsis kha bsgyur ba/ rtse mor rta mgos mtshon pa dang*/ stegs bu gzhan la gtor ma/ mchod pa sman rag phud sogs legs par bshams la/ gnyis pa cho ga la sdom ni/ skyabs sems sngon 'gro gtor ma dang*// mtshams gcod rgyal chen gtor ma dang*/ /tshogs gsog tshad med thugs bskul dang*/ /bdag bskyed bzlas pa rdzas byin rlabs/ /snod bskyed spyan 'dren phyag 'tshal dang*/ /bzhugs gsol mchod sman rak+ta dang*/ /bskang gso bstod pa bshags pa dang*/ /gtor ma tshogs 'khor rjes chog go /ngag 'don ni/ ༈ rdo rje slob dpon sangs rgyas dpal/ /dus gsum bzhugs la skyabs su mchi/ /zhi ba chos dbyings bsam mi khyab/ /dam pa'i chos la skyabs su mchi// theg gsum 'phags pa phyir mi ldog /dge bdun la yang skyabs su mchi/ lan gsum/ deng nas bla med byang chub thos kyi bar/ /bla med byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed cing*/ /byang chub spyod pa thams cad rab spyod la/ /'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas mchog thob shog / lan gsum/ snying pos bsangs/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/

stong pa'i ngang las raṃ yaṃ khaṃ/ raṃ gyi mes bsregs yaṃ gyis gtor/ khaṃ gyis bkrus shing dag par gyur/ oṃ las rin chen 'bar ba'i snod/ /zab cing rgya che hūṃ yig las/ /gtor ma 'dod dgu'i rgya mtshor gyur/ oṃ āḥhūṃ ha ho hrīḥ lan bdun/ oṃ sarba bhu te bh+yo na ma sarba ta thā ga ta bh+yo sogs lan gsum gyis bsngos la/ nyon cig bgegs dang log 'dren rnams/ /nga yi bka' las ma 'da' zhig /gtor ma rgya chen 'di longs la/ /ma 'tshe bar ni gzhan du dengs/ de nas bden brdar ci rigs pa brjod la/ drag sngags dang bcas pas bgegs bskrad par bya'o/ / rang gi snying ga nas rdo rje 'khor lo be con ral gri rgya gram la sogs pa mtshon cha me dpung 'bar ba'i tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab pa spros/ g.yas skor du lan gsum du bskor bas/ gnod byed thams cad thal bar brlag par byas nas rim pa bzhin du/ rdo rje 'khor lo be con ral gri rgya gram rnams kyis sa gzhi ra ba dra ba gur bla bre me dpung 'bar ba dang bcas par 'gyur/ steng yang rdo rje'i bla bre la/ /'og kyang rdo rje sa gzhi ste/ /phyogs mtshams rdo rje 'bar bas gtams/ /rdo rje'i mtshams las ma 'da' shig oṃ badz+ra rak+ṣa tsakra hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ steng yang 'khor lo'i= 'og kyang 'khor lo'i= phyogs mtshams 'khor lo'i mtshams las ma 'da' zhig oṃ tsakra rak+ṣa hūṃ hāṃ phaṭa swāhā/ steng yang be con= 'og kyang be con= phyogs mtshams be con= be con mtshams las= oṃ ḍaṇ+ḍa= steng yang ral gri'i 'og kyang ral gri'i= phyogs mtshams ral gri= ral gri'i mtshams las= oṃ khad ga= steng yang rgya gram= 'og kyang rgya gram= phyogs mtshams rgya gram= rgya gram mtshams las= oṃ nan badz+ra= hūṃ dpal chen mi zad dkyil 'khor nas/ /'bar ba'i khro bo med dpung 'bar/ /gdug pa'i mtshon cha sna tshogs bsnams/ /bgegs dang log 'dren rdul du rlogs/ /dbang chen me dpung dmar nag 'bar/

/bskal pa dus mtha'i me lta bu/ /dbang drag mtshon cha brag ltar gtams/ /gang la bab kyang gcod cing sgrol/ /dbang chen khro mo mi zad rngam/ srid pa'i ye shes khro bo 'khrigs/ /dbang chen mtshams las gang 'da' ba/ /rdul phran bzhin du brlag par bya'o/ /oṃ raṃ kro dha rak+ṣa badz+ra dz+wa la rak+ṣa rak+ṣa dz+wa la raṃ hūṃ/ rgyal chen bzhi'i gtor ma badz+ra yak+ṣa sa bsangs/ rdo rje ma'i sngags rgyas bsregs/ rdo rje bsdams ba'i phyag rgya/ a kā ro'i/ sngags dang bcas pa'i byin gyis brlabs/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ rgyal po chen po bzhi 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ oṃ ḍ+dhi ta ran+ṭa ya/ bhe ru ḍha kā ya/ bhe ru pak+ṣa ya/ bai shra ba na ya/ sa pā ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pā t+yaṃ/ oṃ ḍ+dhi ṭa raṣ+ta sogs sngon du 'gro bas/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta bh+yo sogs gsum gyis phul/ oṃ ḍ+dhi ṭa sogs sngon du 'gro bas/ puṣ+pe/ nas shap+ta 'i bar gyis mchod/ rgyal po chen po dpal ldan pa/ /mar gad mdog mtshungs pi wang 'dzin/ /dri za'i tshogs la dbang bsgyur ba'i/ /yul 'khor bsrung la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dpa' bo chen po stobs po che/ kha dog sngon po ral gri 'dzin/ / grul bum tshogs la dbang bsgyur ba'i/ /'phags skyes po la phyag 'tshal lo/ / mnga' bdag chen po mthu bo che/ kha dog dmar po sbrul zhags 'dzin/ /klu yi tshogs la dbang bsgyur ba'i/ /mig mi bzang la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ded dpon chen po gser mdog can/ /be con dang ni ne'u le 'dzin/ /gnod sbyin tshogs la dbang bsgrur ba'i/ /rnam thos sras la phyag 'tshal lo/ /shar phyogs na ni yul 'khor bsrung*/ /lho phyogs na ni 'phags skyes po/ /nub phyog na ni spyan mi bzang*/ /byang phyogs na ni rnam thos sras/ /'jig rten skyong ba grags ldan pa/ / sde bo che la stobs po che/ kha dog ldan zhing gzi brjid che/ /bka' yi gtor ma 'di long las/ /dkyil 'khor bsgrub pa'i grogs mdzad de/

/bar chad thams cad bsrung ba dang*/ /yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub mdzod/ /rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ bla ma dang dpal pad+ma dbang chen gyi lha tshogs thams cad mdun gyi nam mkhar badz+ra sa ma dzaḥ oṃ ha ya gṛ ba sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ= nas shap+ta'i bar gyi mchod/ ye shes ha ya gṛ ba rta mchog dpal/ /chags med sku ni nub ka'i dmar mtha' ltar/ /'bar ba'i sku la ral pa gyen du brdzais/ /ma rig tshangs pa kha bub gnon pa'i lha/ /pad+ma rig sngags rgyal la phyag 'tshal lo/ / dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ sogs lan gsum/ sems can bde dang ldan gyur cig /sdug bsngal kun dang bral bar shog /bde dang rtag tu mi 'bral zhing*/ /chos kun mnyam nyid rtogs par shog /dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ rnying ma ba spyi la bdag mdun dbyer med du byed pa mang na'ang*/ 'di la nges pas so sor mdzad pa la bar 'dir bdag skyed mngon rtogs ji lta ba bzhin bsgoms la/ bzlas pa ci 'grub bya'o/ / hūṃ a la la ho bha ga wān sa ma ya ho/ 'phags mchog thugs rjes dub la bab/ khyad par bstan pa'i dus la bab/ /mthu rtsal 'byung ba'i dus la bab/ dngos grub stsol ba'i dus la bab/ /dgra bgegs sgrol ba'i dus la bab/ /dam tshig bskang ba'i dus la bab/ /mthu chen mthu stobs rtsol cig bcom ldan 'das/ /dbang chen dbang bskur= byin chen byin rlabs phob cig= dngos grub mchog rnams rtsol cig= bdag gi las 'di'i 'bras bu mchis par mdzod/ oṃ badz+ra aṃ ku sha dzā dzā/ mchod rdzas kyi dri ma rnams raṃ gyi mes bsregs/ āḥyis spel/ hūṃ yig rnams las byung ba'i mchod yon ma dkar mo/ me tog ma ser mo bdug spos ma dkar mo/ /mar me ma dmar skya/ dri chab ma ljang khu rol mo ma kha dog sna tshogs pa rnams dang*/ gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya rdo rje ma rnams dkar sngo ser dmar ljang ba mchod rdzas dpag tu med pa thogs pa rnams kyis sa dang bar snang thams cad gang bar gyur/

oṃ a ha ra a ha ra hūṃ/ lan gsum/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ āḥhūṃ nas shap+ta 'i bar rol mo'i sgra bya/ oṃ a ru pa badz+ra ṇi hūṃ/ shap+ta gan+dhe ra sa spa ra she badz+ri ṇī hūṃ nang mchod gtor ma rak+ta rnams/ stong pa'i ngang las raṃ yaṃ khaṃ gis dri ma sbyangs/ yaṃ las rlung*/ raṃ las me kaṃ las mi mgo'i sgyid pu gsum/ a las thod pa'i nang du sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga/ rlung g.yos me sbar/ rdzas rnams bzhu zhing bskol/ rlangs pa hūṃ oṃ swāhā ā rnams su gyur pa las byung ba'i he ru ka rigs lnga yum dang bcas par gyur/ sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ rjes chags kyi mes 'od du zhu/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ 'khor 'das kyi bdud rtsi thams cad bkug /bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen po gyur/ oṃ āḥhūṃ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta hūṃ hri ṭha/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ te dz+wa ba ling ta ba la ba te gu h+ya sing+nghi sa ma ya hūṃ hrī ṭha/ a las thod pa'i nang du raṃ las dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i sha khrag las byung ba'i bdud rtsi'i rgya mtshor gyur/ oṃ āḥhūṃ mahā rak+ta dz+wa la maṇ+ḍa la hūṃ hri ṭha/ mdun bskyed kyi rten rnams snying pos bsangs/ swabhā wa sa sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las e las chos 'byung sngo/ yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor/ raṃ las me'i dkyil 'khor/ khaṃ las rak+ta'i rgya mtsho'i rba rlabs 'khrugs/ suṃ las maṃ sa'i sa gzhi rgya che ba/ kaṃ las keng rus brtsegs pa'i ri rab steng*/ bh+rūṃ las drag po 'bar ba'i gzhal yas khang*/ /dmar nag gru gsum thod rus 'bar las grub/ /phyi rol dur khrod rin chen gzhal yas khang*/ /dbus su pad zla nyi ma brtsegs pa'i gdan/ /ye shes las grub dkyil 'khor 'khor lor gyur/ de hriḥyig las mngon rtogs bdag bskyed ltar bskyed la/ yang rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ 'og min nas pad+ma dbang chen gyi dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs oṃ badz+ra sa mā dza/ hūṃ chos kyi dbyings las 'khor bcas skur bzhengs shig

/dbang chen khros pa'i rgyal po skur bzhengs shig /ma chags pad+ma 'bar ba'i gzhal yas nas/ /rta mchog rol ba'i khro bo gshegs su gsol/ /ye shes rnam dag sgyu ma'i dkyil 'khor nas/ khro rgyan yab yum mkha' 'gro'i chogs bcas bshegs/ /sna tshogs 'phrin las bya ba'i dkyil 'khor nas/ /bran dang pho nya'i tshogs rnams gshegs su gsol/ mahā sa ma ya dzaḥ sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ hrīḥ rgyal ba kun gyi chos sku pad+ma'i gsung*/ /chos rje 'od dpag med dang rdo rje chos/ /spyan ras gzigs dbang hrīḥlas rngam mchen sku/ /rta mgrin rta skad bzhad la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /sprul pa yang sprul khro bo khro mo dang*/ /rig lnga yab yum sems dpa' sems mar bcas// pho nya bran dang phra men sngags pa'i tshogs/ /'khor dang bcas la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /a ti pu ho/ pra ti dza ho/ hūṃ dam tshig dbang gis dkyil 'khor chen po 'dir/ /ye shes dbang chen 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor mchog /pho brang gsang pa'i dam tshig dkyil 'khor 'dir/ /mi g.yo dges shing brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ ho sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ me tog bdug spos snang gsal sgra/ zhal zas dri chab gtsang ma 'di/ /pad+ma dbang chen dkyil 'khor la/ /'bul gyis yang dag bzhes su gsol/ /oṃ pad+me shwa ra ha ya gṛ ba sa pā ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ya hū ཾ / de bzhin du shap+ta 'i bar du bya'o/ / gzugs kyi lha mo sku mdog dkar/ /phyag na mdzes sdug longs spyod bsnams/ /dbang chen lha yi spyan la 'bul/ /gzugs kyi mchod pa dam pa 'di/ /a la la ste bzhes su gsol/ /sgra yi lha mo sku mdog sngo/ /phyag na mdzes sdug sgra brnyan= dbang chen lha yi snyan la= sgra yis mchod pa dam pa= a la la ste= dri yi lha mo sku mdog ser/ phyag na dri'i dung chos= dbang chen lha yi shangs la= dri mchog mchod pa= a la la ste= ro yi lha mo sku mdog dmar/ /phyag na zhal zas ro mchog=

dbang chen lha yi ljags la= ro yi mchod pa= a la la ste= reg bya'i lha mo sku mdog ljang*/ /phyag na na bza' sna tshogs= dbang chen lha yi sku la= reg bya'i mchod pa dam= a la la ste bzhes su gsol/ oṃ rū pa shap+ta gan+dhe ra sa spar she de bi pū dza āḥhūṃ/ hūṃ rangabyung gdod nas rnam par dag /rtsa brgyad stong la sbyar ba'i sman/ /rig lnga dam tshig lnga yi dngos/ /ye shes lnga rdzogs grub pa'i rdzas/ /rgyud drug sgrib pa kun sgrol phyir/ /dug lnga sel ba'i bdud rtsi 'di/ /ji snyed sangs rgyas thams cad dang*/ /byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs chen la/ /bdag cag dad pas 'bul lags kyi/ /thugs rjes dgongs la bzhes su gsol/ /bzhes nas bdag la dges par mdzod/ /bla med 'phrul gyi dngos grub stsol/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta mahā pañtsa a mṛ ta pū dza kha raṃ khā hi/ /snga rabs 'das pa'i rdo rje slob dpon dang*/ /da ltar bzhugs pa'i rdo rje slob dpon dang*/ /rgyal ba dgongs pa brgyud pa'i bla ma dang*/ /rig 'dzin brda las brgyud pa'i bla ma dang*/ /gang zag snyan khung brgyud pa'i bla ma dang*/ /a mi de ba lo ke shā ra dang*/ /rta mgrin pad+ma 'byung gnas dbon ston sogs/ /rtsa brgyud bla ma rnams la mchod par 'bul/ /thugs rjes dgongs la dbang dang dngos grub stsol/ /'chi med bdud rtsi ra sa ya na yi/ /dam rdzas bdud rtsi'i mchog gi mchod pa 'di/ /pad+ma dbang chen 'khor bcas la/ /bdag nyid dad pas 'bul lags kyi/ /bzhes nas kun tu dges par mdzod/ 'phrul gyi dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /mahā pañtsa a mṛ ta kha raṃ khā hi/ slar yang brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams kyis mtshan gyi mthar 'di zhes bya ba'i bla ma'i zhal du 'bul lo/ / oṃ āḥhūṃ/ bteg la mtheb srin gyi spyi bo'i thad nas nang mchod 'bul/ snying po'i mthar 'bru gsum btags la snying gi thad nas nang mchod 'bul/ /chos skyong sngags la 'bru gsum btags la lte ba'i thad nas nang mchod 'bul/

hūṃ ye shes khro bo dbang chen gyi/ /sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub mchog/ rnal 'byor lus ngag yid la thim/ /gnyis med gyur nas brtan par bya/ kā ya sid+dhi oṃ/ wāka sud+dhi āḥ tsit+ta sid+dhi hūṃ/ zhes dngos grub blangs/ rnam dag rang byung lhun grub sman mchog 'di/ /rta mchog rol pa'i dkyil 'khor 'khor bcas la/ / gus pas mchod pa 'bul lo kha raṃ khā hi/ /mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsal du gsol/ oṃ mahā pañtsa a mṛ ta kha raṃ khā hi/ 'khril ba'i mchod chen mnyam sbyor ba/ /thabs dang shes rab gnyis med pa'i/ /pad+ma la ni rdo rje zhugs/ /gsang ba'i mchod pa'i mchod pas bgyi/ /pad+ma su kha bo dhi tsit+ta swāhā/ rang gi snying ga'i 'od zer gyis dgra bgegs ma lus pa bkug tshar bcad de gtor ma dang rak+ta la thim/ sprul pa'i khro tshogs 'bar ba yis/ /zhing bcu ma lus thams cad dang*/ /'khor ba nyon mongs rgya dral nas/ /dug lnga dbyings su bsgral bar bya/ / sarba sha truṃ mā ra ya phaṭa/ /zhing gyur thams cad dbyings su sgrol/ /sha khrag srog dbugs mchod pa 'di/ /rta mgrin rgyal po'i dkyil 'khor la/ /'bul gyis yang dag bzhes su gsol/ /khyad par 'dod yon mchod pa'i mchog

/sha khrag keng rus rgya mtsho yis/ /gtor ma'i mchod pa dam pa 'di/ /rta mgrin 'khor bcas mnyes gyur cig /mahā maṃ sa khā hī/ /mahā rak+ta khā hi/ /mahā tsit+ta khā hi/ / kaṃ ni ri te hūṃ/ rak+ta gtor ma'i khar bsgrengs/ slar yang mchod pa dang gtor ma gsos snying pos bsangs/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ hūṃ yig las byung ba'i mchod rdzas dang thun rdzas nam mkha'i khams thams cad yongs su gang bas/ khro rgyal rta mgrin 'khor bcas kyi spyan lam du 'byung bar 'gyur cig na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta bh+yoḥ nas/ ga ga na khaṃ swāhā/ lan gsum brjod/ hūṃ mchod yon me tog bdug spos dang*/ /mar me dri chab zhal zas dang*/ / sna tshogs rol mo'i sgra dbyangs kyis/ /rta mgrin 'khor bcas thugs dam bskang*/ /yid sprul mchod pa dpag med dang*/ /mngon bshams sngags dang phyag rgya dang*/ /ting 'dzin mchog gis byin rlabs nas/ /'khor bcas thugs dam skong gyur cig /sangs rgyas dam tshig lcags kyu lnga/ /rig ma'i dam tshig bdud rtsi lnga/ /nang gi mchod pas thugs dam bskang*//ye shes bskyed phyir bzhes su gsol/ /thabs shes dbyer med rig ma'i tshogs/ /phyogs kun khyab par rnam sprul te/ /gsang sngags lha la mchod par 'bul/ /dgyes pa chen po thugs= rang byung mngon shes bsgrub pa'i phyir/ dbang lnga'i puṣ+pes= mkha' 'gro sprin ltar sdud pa'i phyir/ /tshil chen dhu pes= ma rig mun pa sel ba'i phyir/ /zhu chen dī pes= shugs 'gro'i tshogs rnams sdud pa'i phyir/ /mkhris chen gan+dhes= gsang sngags lha rnams mthu bskyed phyir/ /maṃ sa gtor ma'i= dgra bgegs ma lus bsgral ba yi/ /g.yang gzhi bla re 'phan gdugs dang*/ /rgyu rlon lda ldi bar snang brgyan/ /dam nyams skra yi rnga yab g.yob/ /dur khrod chas brgyad sku la gsol/ /mahā rak+ta'i ar+ghaṃ bsgrengs/ /keng rus phub pa'i gzhal yas khang*/ khrag zhag rgya mtsho'i klong dkyil du/ /mi bzad dur khrod brgyad kyis bskor/

/ rgyal srid rin chen sna bdun sogs/ /sna tshogs mchod pa'i thugs= bris sku la sogs phyi yi rten/ /bskyed rim rnal 'byor nang gi rten/ /thig le nyag cig gsang ba'i rten/ /rta mgrin rgyal po'i thugs dam bskang*/ /'khor bcas dgyes shing tshims mdzad la/ /nyams chags bskang zhing dngos grub stsol/ /phyi nang bar chad kun sel zhing*/ /'dod don thams cad 'grub par mdzod/ /hūṃ gzhan yang dam rdzas 'bul ba ni/ khang bzang rnam pa sna tshogs dang*// 'bras bu gsum ro bcu dang sman/ /dkar gsum la sogs bdud rtsi'i zas/ / sbrang rtsi'i la sogs ro zhim mchog /lha rdzas na bza' rnam mang po/ /rin chen cod paṇa do shal sogs/ /sna tshogs rgyan dang chas bkod bcas/ /'khor bcas thugs dam skong gyur cig/bskang ngo bskal ba'i thugs dam bskang*/ / bsgrub bya dbang du sdus pa'i phyir/ /lcags kyu zhags pas thugs dam bskang*/ / dgra bgegs rdul bzhin brlag pa'i phyir/ /gri khug ral gri rtse gsum dang*/ / tho ba dgra sta mdung thung sogs/ /sna tshogs mtshan chas= gnod byed dug gis myos pa'i phyir/ /sbrul chen brgyad kyis= thabs shes zung du 'jug pa'i phyir/ / rdo rje cang te'u thod pa dang*/ /sgra snyan dril bu'i= chos kyi dbyings las bskul ba'i phyir/ /rig sngags gsungs gi bzlas brjod dang*/ /sil snyan rnga zlum rnga bo che/ /pi wang gling bu la sogs pa/ /rol mo glu dbyangs bstod par bcas/ / 'bul gyis kun tu dges par mdzod/ /drag po'i las la bskul ba'i phyir/ don snying sna lnga'i= 'phrin las thams cad bsgrub pa'i phyir/ /sna tshogs srog chags spyan sngar 'bul/ /nor bu'i gzhal med khang pa dang*/ /dar gyi bla bre 'phan gdugs dang*/ /rin chen gdan khri pad nyi zla/ /sgeg mo la sogs lha mo brgyad/ /dpal be la sogs bkra shis brgyad/ /me long la sogs rdzas mchog brgyad/ /ral gri la sogs dngos grub brgyad/ /mdor na longs spyod thams cad dang*/

/gling bzhi ri rab 'jig rten gsum/ /nam mkha' gang bar rnam sprul te/ /pad+ma dbang gi thugs dam bskangs/ /rta mgrin rgyal po'i thugs dam bskang*/ khro chen yab yum= pho nya bran gyi= sprul pa yang sprul= las byed dregs pa'i= dge legs spel phyir bzhes su gsol/ /mgyogs 'gro'i dam tshig yin pa'i phyir/ /bdud rtsi'i sman gyis= khro bo pho nyar 'gyed pa'i phyir/ /dmar chen gtor mas= sprul pa las la bskul ba'i phyir/ /sha chang phud kyis= dam tshig gnyan po gso ba'i phyir/ /tshogs kyi 'khor= mahā rak+ta'i mchod yon 'di/ / dbang phyug nyer brgyad= srog chags nor sna sna tshogs 'di/ skyes bu gying gi= go mtshon sna tshogs bdar ba 'di/ /srog bdag dmar po'i= bdud bshos gos nag la sogs pas/ /bdud rgyal nag po'i= gsang rten rnam pa sna tshogs pas// rdo rje ma mo'i thugs dam bskang*/ /'khor bcas thugs dam skong gyur nas/ / bar chad sel zhing 'dod don sgrubs/ hūṃ ha ya gṛ ba'i dus la bab/ khro rgyal yab yum dus la bab/ /bdag ni rnal 'byor dam tshig ldan/ /rta mchog rol ba'i bka' rtags 'chang*/ /dkyil 'khor lha ni ye shes sku/ /bsrung ma las mkhan mthu rtsal che/ /do nub khyed la mchod pa 'bul/ /dam tshig 'phrin las sgrub tu gsol/ /bdag cag rgyu sbyor la sogs pa'i/ /nad gdon bar chad zhi ba dang*/ /bsrung zhing bzlog par mdzad du gsol/ /tshe ring longs spyod 'phel ba dang*/ /dbang thang 'phrin las kun rgyas shing*/ /mi nor zas sogs 'phel bar mdzod/ /rgyal po rgyal phran blon po dang*// yul mi gtso bo dbang du bsdus/ /sde brgyad dregs can bran du 'khol/ /bsgrub bya dbang byas 'gugs par mdzod/ /sdang ba'i dgra bgegs ma lus pa/ /skad cig tsam gyis thal bar rlogs/ /ma dang smra ba'i dug can rnams/ /rnam shes ye shes mkha' sbyor che/ /ye shes chen po mi shigs pas/ /lus ngan de dag bor du chug

/ye shes dag la sa mā dza/ /drag po'i pho nya da spros shig /mkha' dbyings mi zad khro bos khyab/ /dug gi na bun sprin ltar gtibs/ /mtshon cha 'khrul 'khor char ltar phob/ /rdo rje tho bas mgo bo chom/ /rdo rje dbyug pas rkang lag chog /rdo rje mda' gzhus snying la phug /rdo rje ral gris lus kun gtubs/ / sprul pa'i pho nya thams cad kyis/ /dam nyams dgra bo che ge mo'i/ /gnam gyi 'ju thag skya bo chod/ /sa yi rten phur nag po phyung*/ /las kyi rlung gi rgyab nas phul/ /'jigs pa'i mun pas mdun nas bsus/ khong pa'i nang nas snying thon cig /dbang po lnga dang don sny-ing lnga/ /da lta thon la lus sems khrol/ /sde brgyad dmag dpung sprin ltar gtibs//phyogs kun srin po khros pa dang*/ /ma mo gshin rje khros pas khyab/ /wa dang bya rog bya rgod dang*/ /bya gcan gdug pas gang ba rnams/ kha cig sha za khrag 'thung zhing*/ /la la rus pa lha ba 'jib/ /rgyu ma nang khrol 'ded pa dang*/ /lhu tshigs rus pa 'thor bar mdzod/ /rnam shes mar me ltar bsad nas/ /mtshon char sa mun sros byed pas/ /lus ngag thal ba rdul du rlogs/ /rnam shes dbyings su spor du gsol/ /bdag cag dpon slob 'khor bcas kyi/ /nad kha khram kha dgra la bsgrur/ /chags che nyam nga dgra la bsgrur/ /gnod byed bar chad mi mthun pa/ /thams cad sdang ba'i dgra la bh+yo/ / thams cad gnod pa'i bgegs la bh+yo/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa dar ba dang*/ / sems can bde skyid 'phel bar mdzod/ / bar 'dir bstod pa che chung gsar rnying rnams ci rigs pas bstod cing dbyangs su gyer bar bya'o/ / hūṃ pad+ma dbang chen dkyil 'khor dam pa nas/ /'jig rten 'jig rten 'das pa'i lha tshogs bcas/ /mnyam nyid bzang ngan rtog dang bral na yang*/ / yud tsam bdag gi tshig la dgongs su gsol/ /bdag ni mi shes rmongs shing le lo che/ /sgom sgrub mi brtson bsnyen sgrub g.yel ba dang*/

/dam rdzas ma tshang mchod gtor g.yel ba dang*/ /rgyu chung phud nyams mchod rdzas 'bags pa dang*// cho ga 'khrul dang gsang ba g.yel ba sogs/ /dam tshig 'gal 'khrul thams cad so sor bshags/ /thugs dang 'gal ba thams cad bzod par gsol/ / chos dbyings mnyam pa nyid du dag gyur pas/ /bdag cag bla med bde chen thob par shog / de nas gtor chog ltar gtor ma phul la/ bar 'di myur mdzad mgon po la sogs pa'i chos skyong gang byed kyi gtor ma yang bya'o/ /de nas tshogs kyi mchod pa bya ste/ snga 'gyur rang snang la grags pa'i cho ga rim pa gsum la sogs pa ni 'dir nges par dgos pa ma yin pas/ mdo tsam gzhan dang mthun pa'i 'di ltar spel bar bya ste/ tshogs rdzas rnams sman phud byin rlabs kyi skabs ltar byin gyis brlabs la/ hūṃ e yig bde chen klong yangs su/ /waṃ yig rdo rje rtag 'char ba/ / gsung mchog rdo rje 'od dpag med/ /mtha' yas sems dpa'i tshogs dang bcas/ khyed kyi rjes su bdag bsgrub phyir/ /byin gyis rlob phyir gshegs su gsol/ /gnas khang 'di la byin phob la/ /tshogs rdzas 'di la bcud cig chug/ 'dir 'dul rnal 'byor bdag cag la/ /mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol// 'gro la thugs rjes chen po yis/ /rang snang ri bo ta la nas/ /'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang la/ /lha klu gnod sbyin tshogs kyis bskor/ khyed kyi rjes su= byin gyi rlabs= gnas khang = tshogs rdzas 'di la= 'dir 'dus rnal 'byor= mchog dang thun mong = lho nub rnga yab srin po'i gling*/ /pad+ma 'od kyi gzhal yas su/ /slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas la/ /'khor du mkha' 'gro mang pos bskor/ khyed kyi= byin gyis brlabs= gnas khang = tshogs rdzas= 'dir 'dus= mchog dang = gangs can sa yi thig le mchog /skye sgang snying rje'i pho brang nas/ / dbon ston dharmā seng ha ni/ /skal ldan dag pa'i 'khor gyis bskor/ khyod kyi= byin gyis=

gnas khang = tshogs rdzas= 'dir 'dus= mchog dang = phyogs bcu dag pa'i zhing khams nas/ /byin rlabs thugs rjes ldan pa yi/ /drin can brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams/ /rig 'dzin du ma'i 'khor dang bcas/ khyod kyi= byin gyis brlabs= gnas khang = tshogs rdzas= 'dir 'dus= mchog dang = rang snang dag pa'i gzhal yas khang*/ /gar bzhugs 'og min gnas mchog nas/ / kun bzang rtsa ba'i bla ma la/ /brgyud ldan bla ma'i tshogs dang bcas/ khyod kyi= byin gyis= gnas khang = tshogs rdzas= 'dir 'dus= mchog dang = sde brgyad bran du 'khol ba'i zhing*/ /dmar nag 'bar ba'i klong dkyil nas/ khro rgyal rta mchog rol pa yang*/ /yi dam lha tshogs rnams kyis bskor/ khyed kyi= byin gyis= gnas khang = tshogs rdzas= 'dir 'dus= mchog dang = he ru ka yis byin brlabs pa/ /sum bcu rtsa gnyis gnas mchog nas/ /bgrang yas dpa' bo mkha' 'gro la/ /sprul pa nyid sprul tshogs dang bcas/ khyed kyis= byin gyis brlabs= gnas khang = tshogs rdzas= 'dir 'dus= mchog= gdug can dgra bgegs sgrol ba'i zhing*/ /dur khrod chen po'i gnas brgyad nas/ /myur mdzad ye shes mgon po ni/ /dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs dang bcas/ /khyed kyi rjes su bdag slob kyi/ /byin gyis rlobs phyir gshegs su gsol/ /bla ma yid dam mkha' 'gro'i tshogs/ /rigs kyi cod pan sdem se sdem/ /dar gyi cod pan pu ru ru/ /rgyan cha mang po khra la la/ /rol mo mang po di ri ri/ /glu len gar byed khyug se khyug /'khor tshogs 'bum sde sha ra ra/ /sgyu ma'i rang snang rjen ne ne/ /gtad med rig pa gsal la la/ /brjod med dbyings su thal la la/ /bde ba chen por khril li li/ /byin gyis rlobs phyir gshegs su gsol/ /gnas khang 'di la byi phob la/ /sgrub mchog bdag la dngos grub stsaul/ /bgegs dang log 'dren bar chad sol/ /'khor gsum gnyis su med par 'dres/ tshogs kyi spyi phud phul la/ na mo thabs dang shes rab gnyis su med pa'i tshogs kyi 'khor lo rgya chen po rang bzhin rnam par dag pa skye ba med pa/

mtshan nyid rnam par dag pa ā li kā li'i ngo bo rnam par dag pa sha lnga bdud rtsi lngas rgyas btab pa 'di/ byin rlabs kyi rtsa ba rtsa brgyud bla ma rnams kyi zhal du ga na tsakra pañtsa a mṛ ta pū dza kha kha khā hi khā hi/ dngos grub kyi rtsa ba yi dam lha tshogs rnams kyi zhal du kha kha khā hi khā hi/ 'phrin las kyi rtsa ba chos skyong bsrung ma rnams kyi zhal du kha kha khā hī khā hī/ dam tshig gi rtsa ba mched grogs rdo rje spun grogs rnams kyi zhal du kha kha khā hī khā hī/ de nas snying po'i mthar gtor sngags btags la/ yi dam la lan gsum phul/ chos skyong gi gtor sngags la kha kha btags la phul/ mkha' 'gro spyi gtor yang 'bul/ las kyis rdo rjes/ gzigs shig mdzes pa dam pa'i chos/ /'di la the tshom bya mi rung*/ /bram ze khyi dang gdol pa gsum/ /rang bzhin gcig tu lhan cig rol/ zhes so sor drangs so/ /so sos kyang*/ rin thang med chos legs par 'ongs/ /'dod chags kyi ni dri ma spangs/ /blang dang blang min las grol ba/ /'di nyid phul ba ngo mtshar che/ zhes blangs/ thams cad kyis phud spyi 'bungs su bsdus nas/ oṃ dman pa'i yul las rab 'das shing*/ /rgyal ba kun gyi dam tshig mchog /dngos grub kun gyi gzhir gyur pa/ /bdud rtsi mchog gi mchod pa bzhes/ /sgrib pa'i dri ma kun sel zhing*/ / rtog pa kun las rnam grol ba/ /bla na med pa'i byang chub sems/ /bde ba chen por mnyes gyur cig /gzugs dang sgra dang dri dang ro/ /reg byas khyad par mchis pa rnams/ /rtsa brgyud bla ma rnams la 'bul/ /mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol/ /gzugs dang sgra dang = reg bya'i khyad par= yi dam lha tshogs= mchog dang thun mong = gzugs dang sgra dang = reg bya'i khyad par= bstan bsrung rgya mtsho'i tshogs= dngos grub ma lus stsal du gsol/ /gzugs dang sgra dang dri dang ro/ reg bya'i= gnas gsum mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la

'bul/ /phyi nang bar chad zhi bar mdzod/ /gzugs dang sgra dang dri dang ro/ / reg bya'i khyad par mchis pa rnams/ dkar phyogs skyong ba rnams la 'bul/ / bsam pa 'grub pa'i sdong grogs mdzod/ a kā ro/ lan gsum gyis phul/ lha'i rnal 'byor gyi sgo nas tshims par za'o/ / hūṃ sangs rgyas kun gyis byin rlabs pa/ /'od zer sna lnga'i dra bas mdzes/ /seng ge 'phrog byed tshangs dbang gtso/ /thugs brtser mdzod cig te na hūṃ/ de na hūṃ de na te te hūṃ/ zhes klu blangs/ lte bar gtum mo 'bar ba yis/ /de bzhin gshegs pa lnga bsregs te/ /spyan la sogs pa yang bsregs te/ / bsregs pa'i ro bong can haṃ 'dzag / ces bde ba bsgom/ de nas tshogs lhag bsdus la/ bsangs sbyangs/ oṃ āḥhūṃ ha ho hrīḥ ma mo nag mo dud pa'i sol ba mo lhag sdud kyi rdo rje pho nya mo'i tshogs dang bcas pa thams cad lhag ma'i dam tshig gi gnas su badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ oṃ ma ga ri ye sa pā ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ= nas shap+ta 'i bar gyis mchod/ oṃ hūṃ ma ga ri ye sa pā ri wā ra bh+yaḥ a kā ro= sogs lan bdun gyis phul/

ma mo nag mo dud pa'i sol ba mo/ lhag sdud kyi rdo rje pho nya mo'i tshogs dang bcas pa rnams/ lhag ma'i gtor ma 'dis tshim par gyis la bdag cag rnams kyi 'phrin las thogs pa med par bsgrub shig /phyi rol sgo drug na gnas pa'i 'byung po 'chol ba'i tshogs dam tshig gi cho ga la blta bar mi dbang pa rnams la sbyin no/ /rdo rje theg pa la gsang ba mchog gi sgor spyod pa'i skal ba dang ldan par gyur cig oṃ ba ling ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ u tsiṣ+ta bhak+ṣa si swāhā/ snying po bzlas shing lhag gtor phyir rol du dor/ de nas brgyud pa'i bla ma'i gsol 'debs dang/ yi dam gyi bstod pa mdor bsdus tsam gyis bstod nas/ slob dpon dang dpal khro bo'i rgyal po rta mchog rol ba'i lha tshogs/ mkha' 'gro chos skyong bsrung ma'i lha tshogs dang bcas pa rnams kyis/ bdag dang sems can thams cad la mchog dang thun mongs kyis dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ dpral ba nas 'od zer dkar po byung*/ rang gi dpral bar thim/ mgrin pa nas dmar po dang/ thugs ka nas sngon po dang*/ gnas gsum char nas dkar dmar mthing gsum byung*/ rang gi gnas gsum du thim/ dbang bzhi thob par bsam zhing*/ snga 'gyur kyi cho ga gzhan dang 'brel ba slob dpon pad+ma'i bka' bsrung dam can/ spyi sgos rnams kyi gtor ma dang*/ khyad par bstan skyong bya bar 'dod na skabs 'dir bya'o/ /yi ge brgya pa mang du bzlas/ de nas/ ma 'byor pa dang nyams pa dang*/ zhes sogs kyis bzod par gsol/ bris sku la brtan bzhugs spyi dang mthun par bya/ khyod kyi sems can don kun mdzad/ sogs kyis gtor mgron rnams spyi dang mthun par gshegs/ sems can thams cad bde gyur cig / ces sogs kyis smon las btab bkra shis bka' rgya mas thog drangs te/ shis brjod ci 'grub bya'o/ / grub pa kun gyis nyer bsten pa/ /dbang chen gsang ba'i sgrub thabs kyi/

/'phrin las cho ga 'dir gsal byas/ /dge 'dis 'gro kun sangs rgyas shog /dpal khro bo'i rgyal po rta mchog rol ba gsang sgrub kyi las byang dregs pa kun 'dul zhes bya ba 'di ni chos 'di nyid la mchog tu gus pa dang ldan pa/ /'phrin las rnam rgyal zhes bya bas/ /lugs 'di la yi ge 'thor thabs su gnas pa las/ /chog sgrigs gsal ba ches dkon par 'dug pa'i/ /las byang gsal ba zhig sgrig par 'os so zhes yang yang bskul ba la brten nas/ shangs pa bka' rgyud kyi chos rigs su skyes pa rgyal khams pa tā ra nā thas rang lo nyer brgyad pa la chos 'khor sdengs su bkod pa'o// // zhu dag/maṅgalaṃ// mes po'i shul bzhag las/ tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum/dpal khro bo'i rgyal po rta mchog rol ba'i las byang dregs pa kun 'dul bzhugs/ -PAGE 208--PAGE 209--PAGE 191-
